name: Simon Stears
profile: One of the best players in the group, a natural 9, now back up to speed after injury. Played at a high level, great footballing brain, does a lot of talking and organising. The single biggest lifter in this group: on 27 August 2026 he dictated and organised a non-bibs side that won 8-3, and players around him — John Bassil, Ryan Cooper — played well above their ratings all night. Treat having Simon on a side as worth more than his own rating suggests.
